ModMetaData.name: Anomaly Amputation
ModMetaData.author: JalapenoLabs (adapted)
ModMetaData.description:
Adapt anomaly containment to your needs by surgically disarming captured entities.
This mod allows gorehulks held on a containment platform to receive standard medical bills so you can amputate specific limbs. Removing limbs increases containment reliability and slows their resource output.
Work in progress prototype derived from the Electricity Meter infrastructure.
